additional_info.subject: RE: ID0411636-DC/Si-D/FR-[Q2MW2c] Transcations failing CRM:01410001547
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0411636 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
yes
Onsite Troubleshooting
yes
End Customer Communication
yes
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
We can see in the logs
DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)
And the error which has been generated that are
:
VIV: 0 = all input sensor measurements are invalid
PLE: 1 = Plausibility Error (difference of two sensors of same type too high)
Kindly refer mentioned steps to be followed to trouble shoot the fault which is leading to this error flags.
Step 1:
Turn off the power supply to the charger.
Step 2:
Identify the cables P1, P2, N1 & N2 associated to Pt1000 refer the pictures for your ref.
Step 3:
Check the ambient temperature and note it, then using multimeter measure the resistance of P1, P2, N1 & N2.
Step 4:
Click on the following link to see the resistance table of Pt 1000 pertaining to the temperature and its corresponding resistance.
https://www.sterlingsensors.co.uk/pt1000-resistance-table
If it is possible please carry a resistor along with you as per temp mentioned in above table so that we can check the KF13 also.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shreyas Sathe

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
